description: Search Lebanese legislation (laws, decrees, decisions), their articles, court rulings, or Official Gazette issues, by keyword: Arabic words, French words (articles the Centre published in French, and the codes' French or English names), or a law's numeric id. Returns verbatim snippets from the Lebanese University's database, never an AI-written summary. A ruling hit's pdf_url is its full judgment's scan on the Lebanese University's site: always pass it on with any answer that cites the ruling. English words work too: they are read into Arabic through a glossary, matched against the unofficial English titles, and when nothing matches the result says what was searched instead (searched_instead). Each law carries title_en, an unofficial English title a model wrote from the Arabic title alone: the Arabic title and text are official and more accurate; cite the Arabic. Not legal advice.

kind.description: narrow to one category; omit to search all four

query.description: words to search for, Arabic, English or French, or a law's id

year.description: only laws issued this year (applies when kind is "laws" or omitted)

name: search_legislation
